# Historical execution audit

**Provenance.** Expanded files share root `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/`. Below, paths beginning `outputs/` are relative to that root. Archive paths are under `work/scene_archive/bundles/`; members have the corresponding `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/results/…` suffix. Line citations refer to the original numbered files, not lines within escaped Blender logs.

## Classroom, bw_0005

**Generated representation and intent.** The selected pilot code builds a Montessori classroom from semantic assets and primitives: a room shell, five framed windows with translucent glass, geometric exterior trees, seven open cabinets, two tables, five stools, a two-disc rug, trays with blocks or cylindrical “bowls,” plants and a wall display. The foreground island is specified as 2.65 × 0.95 × 0.98, with separate boards, dividers and toes. These are code dimensions, not independently measured geometry. Explicit support heights and ownership express intended relationships, but do not establish physical contact or fidelity. [X0386, `outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/external/scene_rsi_pilot/selected/external/bw_0005/steps/003/build.py`, archive `external--scene_rsi_pilot.tar.gz`, member `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/results/external/scene_rsi_pilot/selected/external/bw_0005/steps/003/build.py`, lines 51–154, 156–219]

Wood-owner materials receive roughness 0.78 and generated-coordinate noise, stretched by (1.5, 28, 5), feeding a 0.10-strength bump; this is procedural shading, not an image texture. The selected camera is (2.6, −6.2, 3.0), aimed at (−0.45, 1.1, 0.85), lens 31. Two area lights have powers 1050 and 230; world strength is 0.48. The code leaves render settings to the runner. [X0386, same provenance, lines 21–22, 221–285]

The revisions describe camera-only changes: step 1 used (4, −7.3, 3.8), lens 29; step 2 moved closer to (1.8, −4.4, 2.65); step 3 retreated to recover the island base and rug. Comments describe the step-2 island as cropped and surfaces as too pale, but these are author visual estimates, not independently verified observations or proof that step 3 improved the image. [X0382, `outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/external/scene_rsi_pilot/selected/external/bw_0005/steps/001/build.py`, archive `external--scene_rsi_pilot.tar.gz`, corresponding member, lines 5–18; X0384, same directory, `steps/002/build.py`, corresponding archive/member, lines 14–27; X0386, lines 4–19]

**Execution and validation.** Pilot steps 1–3 each report `ok: true`, empty stderr, a finished 16/16-sample Blender render and saved PNG and blend file. Step 3 took 8.67 seconds in its render log. These records demonstrate completion, not visual quality. [X0383, X0385, X0387, respectively `outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/external/scene_rsi_pilot/selected/external/bw_0005/steps/001`, `002`, `003` `/result.json`, archive `external--scene_rsi_pilot.tar.gz`, corresponding members, lines 2–7]

`selected.json` records step 3; the record says complete and valid, with overall 0.3129, SSIM 0.1197 and LPIPS 0.9393. Structural, material and composite operability pass for `back_left_plant`; semantic completeness and support/collision truth are null. These numeric results and passes are not independent acceptance of reconstruction quality. No image was supplied for this audit. [X0380, `outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/external/scene_rsi_pilot/selected/external/bw_0005/selected.json`, corresponding pilot archive/member, line 2; X0379, same directory `record.json`, corresponding archive/member, lines 16–34, 49–57]

A separate fixed-h0 classroom step 3 specifies Cycles, 64 samples and 1920 × 1080, but its execution log reports 16/16 samples; it also reports success and saved output. Do not substitute the code’s requested settings for the observed sample count. [X0375, `outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/external/fixed_h0/selected/external/bw_0005/steps/003/build.py`, archive `external--fixed_h0.tar.gz`, corresponding member, lines 262–283; X0376, same directory `result.json`, corresponding archive/member, lines 2–7]

## Clean laboratory, bw_0011

The fixed-h0 attempts intended blue panel walls, a glazed stainless cabinet, botanical mural and suspended ceiling. Step 1 failed before rendering because a 0.085 fillet exceeded half the 0.018-thick pane; step 2 reduced the radius to 0.008 but timed out at approximately 600 seconds with no image. The timeout does not establish which phase consumed the time. [X0391, `outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/external_followup/fixed_h0/selected/external_followup/bw_0011/steps/001/build.py`, archive `external_followup--fixed_h0.tar.gz`, corresponding member, lines 39–57; X0392, same step `result.json`, lines 2–7; X0393, step 002 `build.py`, lines 69–73; X0394, step 002 `result.json`, lines 2–7; all corresponding archive members]

Step 3 replaced numerous solid filaments with three planar ribbon meshes and requested Cycles 32 samples, denoising and six bounces. It instead failed while assigning the mural material: an object’s `data` was `None`; subsequent ribbon, camera and lighting code cannot be claimed executed. The record reports missing blend or PNG and failed validation, despite null runtime-status error. This is a technical execution failure, not a completed poor render. [X0395, same fixed-h0 directory, `steps/003/build.py`, lines 162–175, 310–333; X0396, `steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0389, `record.json`, lines 16–31, 46–50; archive `external_followup--fixed_h0.tar.gz`, corresponding members]

A separate pilot laboratory build describes an illumination-only revision after a purported successful step 1, but no corresponding execution result or selection is supplied here; its predicted darker appearance remains unverified. [X0398, `outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/external_followup/scene_rsi_pilot/selected/external_followup/bw_0011/build.py`, archive `external_followup--scene_rsi_pilot.tar.gz`, corresponding member, lines 6–18, 31–38]
